title: Go panic with goroutine dump disclosed in a response
description: The response body contains a Go runtime panic followed by a goroutine dump. The dump lists the call stack of every active goroutine with function names, source file paths and argument words, so a single failing request maps the service internals. The check reports the disclosed dump; it does not claim the panic is reachable on demand.
remediation: Recover panics at the HTTP boundary (a middleware with recover()) and return a generic error response with a correlation id.
limitation: Observation-level: requires the 'goroutine N [running]:' header that the Go runtime prints. A panic message without the dump header is not reported.

observation.body:
panic: runtime error: index out of range [3] with length 2

goroutine 1 [running]:
main.handler(0x0, 0x0)
